Road conditions

  • (888) 588-2848

When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8' 6” wide,
  • Semi-trailer over 53' 6" long,
  • Over 13' 6"high

Special Information Needed

  • Date and time of movement
  • Truck make, license # and state
  • Physical address if starting or stopping inside state
  • Overweight-need original origin and destination
  • Containerized-need to know what's inside container

Times Of Movement

  • Daylight hours only; no Sunday travel
  • Loads 120’-150’ restricted from 9am-3pm M-F
  • Travel prohibited on the following holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Thanksgiving & Friday- Sunday after, Christmas
  • Permit office closed on the above holidays as well as Martin Luther King Day, Washington’s Birthday, Columbus Day, Confederate Memorial Day, Jefferson Davis’ Birthday, & Veteran’s Day (Travel not restricted)

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • Over 12' to 14’ wide-1 front escort on 2 lane roads or 1 rear for multilane roads
  • Over 14’ wide require 1 front & 1 rear escort on all roads
  • Over 90' to 125' long- 1 pilot car in rear; over 125’- 150’-2 pilots (1 pilot car in front & 1 pilot car in rear)
  • Over 150’-front and rear law enforcement escorts
  • Over 15' 6” high- 1 pilot car in front w/ height pole
  • Overhang in rear more than 5'- 1 rear pilot car
  • Overhang in front more than 10'- 1 front pilot car
  • For bulldozers & other construction equipment w/ blade intact that protrudes beyond the transporting vehicle: 1 escort (minimum)
  • http://www.dot.state.al.us/business/permits/pdf/RulesAndRegulations.pdf

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • 
  • Lights: Must be equipped w/ a flashing or strobe amber lights
  • 
  • Signs: Mounted on front & rear or on roofline of any escort. Shall contain the wording “OVERSIZE LOAD”; 7’ x 18”; black letters 10” high w/ 1 .4”-1.5’” brush stroke on a yellow or orange background. Height /width may be modified to fit the vehicle while maintaining color scheme & letter size.
  • 
  • Additional equipment: Radio to allow communication between the pilot/escort and load

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • Drivers of escort vehicles must be a minimum of eighteen (18) years of age, have a valid driver’s license, and have completed a pilot/escort flagging course which equals or exceeds Alabama’s course within twelve (12) months of Alabama’s course availability.
  • Dept. of Transportation Permits Office- Office hours: 7am-4:45pm CT
  • P.O. Box 303050
  • Montgomery, AL 36130
  • 800-499-2782 option 4
  • Fax: (334) 832-9084
